gloss: end of a consecutive holiday; first day back after a long weekend

definitions.gloss: end of a consecutive holiday; first day back after a long weekend
definitions.explanation: The period immediately following a series of consecutive days off, typically referring to the first working day after a long weekend or holiday period like Golden Week or Obon.

examples.japanese: {連休明|れんきゅうあ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧。
examples.english: The day after a long weekend is tough.

examples.japanese: {連休明|れんきゅうあ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|こ}む→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The Monday after a long weekend is crowded on the trains.

examples.japanese: {連休明|れんきゅうあ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溜|た}まっていて→溜まる：02067_tamaru⟧、⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{半日|はんにち}→半日：27978_hannichi⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: A huge number of emails had piled up after the holidays, and it took me half a day to get through them.

notes:
USAGE:
{連休明|れんきゅうあ}け uses the suffix ⟦{明|あ}け→明ける：21288_akeru⟧, meaning "the period after" or "the end of." This pattern is productive: {正月明|しょうがつあ}け (after New Year), {夏休|なつやす}み{明|あ}け (after summer break), ⟦{梅雨明|つゆあ}け→梅雨明け：08338_tsuyuake⟧ (end of rainy season).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連休明|れんきゅうあ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (work after the holidays)
- {連休明|れんきゅうあ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧ (to arrive after the long weekend)
- ⟦ゴールデンウィーク→ゴールデンウィーク：22760_goorudenwiiku⟧⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧ (after Golden Week)
